purpose: Independent live-browser research; proposed stable visible-text anchors only, not scoring or a frozen reference.
method: Read project AGENTS.md and complete Browser skill/documentation; opened four own tabs at exactly the requested URLs. Used rendered DOM, exact-text element inspection and cropped visual checks. No provider outputs, existing references, cookies, credential files, login submissions, CAPTCHA solving or remote mutations used.
limitations: Stability is a proposal based on control/section semantics, not longitudinal proof.
DOM classes and pixel positions are observation evidence, not durable selectors or acceptance requirements.
Generic site navigation, login/verification content, footer text, current members, titles, ranks, prices, heat and counts are excluded from proposed body anchors.
Only task-related text is retained here; no raw page snapshots, account-specific header information, delivery location or tokenized content URLs are retained.
Browser blockage alone does not invalidate an existing task; these observations do not replace previously supplied independent evidence.
